needed.evidence: No footway on the right side of the road, pedestrians walking in the carriageway
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous sidewalk with a physical barrier separating the footway from the carriageway on the right side of the road.

needed.evidence: No footway on the left side of the road, pedestrians walking in the carriageway
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous sidewalk on the left side of the road to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Zebra crossing is poorly marked and obstructed by parked cars, making it difficult for pedestrians to cross safely
needed.suggestion: Upgrade the zebra crossing to a signalised crossing with a refuge island to ensure pedestrian safety and improve visibility.

needed.evidence: No dropped kerbs at the zebra crossing
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at both ends of the zebra crossing to facilitate safe pedestrian access.

needed.evidence: No street lights visible along the road in an urban area
needed.suggestion: Install street lights along the road to improve visibility and safety for both pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.
